title: Alert Policy Config Registry
description: Registers all policy, severity, schedule, contact, and escalation schema files for the alert-notification capability.

severity-levels.description: Severity level definitions with default routing and mandatory route flags.

contact-group.description: Contact group with member list and optional schedule reference.

schedule.description: On-call schedule with shifts and exceptions.

escalation-step.description: Escalation step with timing, target group, channels, and alternate channels.

channel-capability.description: Channel capability definition with tier, supported states, max state, and rate limits.
